statement.zh: 所有巨石头像都已确认为可指认的历史统治者肖像。
statement.en: All colossal heads are confirmed portraits of identifiable historical rulers.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: portrait-of-ruler readings are common but not individually demonstrable for every head from inscriptions.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only. Density pass 4 (D-2026-10-12-4); bibliographic details verified via WebSearch/catalog pages 2026-10-12; no invented page numbers/coordinates/forged images.
